request.purpose: Construction work is physically demanding. We want to screen job applicants for a history of this disease and not hire the affected ones.
request.question: In which federal states is type 2 diabetes most common among people aged 65 or older?
definitions: Older person = aged 65 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes is identified by any diagnosis whose ICD-10 code begins with E11.
Prevalence = older persons with type 2 diabetes / all older persons in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: older persons, older persons with type 2 diabetes and the prevalence.
